text:
maria: quick heads-up — planning a geo-drip for model v13 today. plan: start at 5% in eu-west-1, hold for 30m, then +5% to 10% if metrics look good. need quick sign-off + checklist.

sam: 👍 what's the rollback trigger? latency/error/quality thresholds?

maria: rollback if p95 latency > 900ms (+20% vs baseline) OR 5xx rate > 0.3% OR eval-set similarity drop > 2%. abort immediately on any production degradation alert. cc @jonah @lia

jonah: oncall ok. i'll watch SLOs and can flip the flag. recommend a hard fallback to v12 for eu if errors spike — short-circuit in routing.

lia: please ensure EU burst rate-limiter is set to 200 rps and batching config stays the same. also request an explicit protective-cap in the flag metadata.

sam: sample flag config: ```json
{"flag":"model.v13.geo_drip","regions":{"eu-west-1":5},"max_rps":200,"auto_ramp":false,"rollback_triggers":{"p95_latency_ms":900,"5xx_rate_pct":0.3}}
```

maria: thanks. we'll run a short smoke test now against the non-prod shadow and then flip the feature. deploy will post when toggle is created.

deploy-bot: Toggle created: model.v13.geo_drip in 'eng' environment. ID: toggle-9843. Command: `rctl toggle set toggle-9843 --region eu-west-1 --percent 5`

jonah: started watching. if i see >0.2% 5xx or latency creep i'll rollback and ping #eng-oncall.

lia: added alert: `model_v13_geo_5xx_eu` (3m window). also enabled 100% log sampling for the first 30m.

maria: ok flipping in 2 min. i'll post a heatcheck after ~15m. @sam can you double-check telemetry dashboard shows p95 baseline overlay?

sam: will do. pulling baseline now.

maria: flip done — https://deploys.redwood.internal/toggle/toggle-9843 :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Toggle set: toggle-9843 — eu-west-1 @ 5% (initiated by maria)

jonah: seeing initial traffic. p95 ~ 480ms, 5xx 0.02%. no anomalies so far.

lia: logs look clean; sampling confirmed.

maria: marking as 'in-monitoring'. will ramp to 10% after 30m if green. thanks all :rocket:
